open_points.subject: Registry frontend credential boundary
open_points.text: “How the frontend obtains the staff credential belongs to the frontend” conflicts with the browser calling the API directly, while R0-23 names only the operator and a frontend server as holders of that credential.
open_points.question: For a Registry frontend running in a browser on Registry’s host, which actor holds and presents the staff credential, and is that browser inside the secrets trust boundary?
options: The browser holds the shared staff credential
A same-host frontend server holds it and proxies staff actions
Staff enter the credential into the browser for each session
The direct browser frontend supports only unauthenticated reads
open_points.default_guess: Treat a same-host frontend server as the credential holder and have it proxy staff actions.
